summary: lasers + tasers hit people that are lying down (turrets don't suck any more)

comments.content:
Also adds a 3 second delay between turret firing because (in my tests) they
were way too lethal without that. Also, lasers don't always hit you in the
chest - this meant that, as long as you were otherwise healthy, it was
literally impossible for just lasers to kill you (even an infinite number
of them).
